w: The old Cathedral of Saint Nicholas stood on this spot until 1874, when it came down and this one rose in its place, rededicated to the Immaculate Conception. Seat of the Archdiocese of Monaco in the Monaco-Ville ward, it's known to everyone simply as the Cathedral of Monaco.
s: Rebuilt after the old cathedral came down in 1874
_facts: Roman Catholic cathedral of the Archdiocese of Monaco, in the Monaco-Ville ward
Formerly called the Cathedral of Saint Nicholas, which was demolished in 1874
Dedicated to the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Immaculate Conception
Informally known as the Cathedral of Monaco
